verdict.rationale: The only evidence touching triage is the MCP documentation, which says users can browse issues and resolve them (glitchtip-docs-10). Teams exist but are described only as routing notifications, not as assigning an issue owner (glitchtip-docs-18). Missing for 10: assigning an owner to an issue, ignore/mute, snooze, automatic reopening of resolved issues on regression, and first-party triage-workflow docs or hands-on corroboration.
